meta.name: esm
meta.description: Uses the Biohub esm Python SDK for ESM3 protein generation, ESMC embeddings, and ESMFold2 all-atom folding. Applies to local model inference and Biohub hosted clients, including former Forge workflows; distinguishes the separate legacy fair-esm distribution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入序列或结构需求,生成蛋白质序列、嵌入向量与全原子折叠结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在本地或托管服务上跑蛋白质生成、嵌入与折叠计算。
copy.tagline_en: Generate protein sequences, embeddings, and all-atom folded structures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run protein generation, embedding, or folding jobs locally or via hosted clients.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 esm Python SDK 跑 ESM3 蛋白质序列生成、ESMC 嵌入向量提取和 ESMFold2 结构折叠,可用本地权重或 Biohub/Forge 托管推理。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 esm Python SDK、提到 ESM3 或 ESMC 模型 ID、或做 Forge/Biohub 推理与结构折叠时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 补全这段带下划线掩码的蛋白序列。
say.note: 返回补全后的完整序列。

say.text: 用 esmc_300m 算这批蛋白序列的嵌入向量。
say.note: 输出可供下游分析的嵌入。

say.text: 把这段序列跑结构预测,给我 PDB 坐标。
say.note: 返回 3D 坐标和 PDB 字符串。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the esm Python SDK to run ESM3 protein sequence generation, ESMC embeddings, and ESMFold2 folding, via local weights or Biohub/Forge hosted inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, cite ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, or use Forge/Biohub inference clients and folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this masked protein sequence with esm3-open.
Compute ESMC embeddings for these sequences with esmc_300m.
Predict the structure of this sequence and give me the PDB.
say_en.note: Returns 3D coordinates and a PDB string.
